title: Synthetic Children and Teen AI Safety Policy

sections.title: Children under thirteen
sections.text: An AI experience directed to children under thirteen must not launch without verified parental authorization, age-appropriate notice, strict data minimization, short retention, safety testing, and a staffed escalation path. Open-ended companionship is prohibited until these safeguards are independently approved.

sections.title: Teen safety controls
sections.text: Teen-facing generative AI must include age assurance, age-appropriate defaults, prohibited-content controls, crisis escalation, reporting, and parental or guardian controls where appropriate. Safety classifiers must be evaluated for teen-specific risks.

sections.title: Minor monitoring and consequential actions
sections.text: Biometric or behavioral monitoring of minors in education requires accessibility review, documented necessity, human review of every flag, an appeal process, and evidence that disability-related behavior does not create disproportionate false positives.
